title: 2003 AMC 8 Problem 12
statement: When a fair six-sided die is tossed on a table top, the bottom face cannot be seen. What is the probability that the product of the numbers on the five faces that can be seen is divisible by \(6?\)

solutions.text:
If the face numbered \(6\) is visible, then the visible product is divisible by \(6.\)

If the face numbered \(6\) is on the bottom, then the visible faces include both \(2\) and \(3,\) so their product is still divisible by \(6.\)

Every possible toss works, so the probability is \(1.\)

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Check the only case where the face numbered \(6\) is hidden.
If \(6\) is hidden, the visible faces still include \(2\) and \(3.\)
